sources.title: ncnn - AI Model Insights & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: ncnn is a high-performance neural network inference computing framework optimized for mobile platforms. ncnn is deeply considerate about deployment and uses on mobile phones from the beginning of design. ncnn does not have third-party dependencies. It is cross-platform and runs faster than all known open-source frameworks on mobile phone cpu.
